Mechanism is real and verifiable from the diff.

records.issue_text: [BUG] Usernames are split on "," without stripping whitespace or reporting unknown users, so 'bob, fred' looks up ' fred' which matches nothing, and every miss is silently dropped while the action still renders success_json. An admin pasting a comma-separated list with spaces gets a green success response with some or all members silently not added; the client then reloads a member list that doesn't include the names the admin just typed, with no error to explain why.
records.rationale: Reused frozen D-verified defect assignment; no new classifier call
